limitations: Wall attribution is instrumented, not a throughput comparison or measured speedup.
C++seconds includes model+consumed-history+sampler; excludes command parsing and response formatting/flushing.
Command wall minus C++seconds includes pipe/scheduling/JSON/Python overhead; it is not pure IPC.
Tokenizer and JSON serialization are directly timed; HTTP/network write/flush/backpressure and browser rendering are not measured.
No worker-wait duration is attributed to removable synchronization.
No full-logit arithmetic change: identical immutable executable; finite stream equivalence is checked, not a new absolute numerical qualification.
Two repeat controls are diagnostics, not ten-pair performance evidence.

archive_provenance.sanitization: Repository/home paths and process identifiers removed. All visits and observations retained.
archive_provenance.stream_equality_scope: Visible generated IDs/text and finish reason; terminal EOS token ID is suppressed by the adapter and was not independently compared.
